propositions: A read-only, S3-backed live Jira Cloud multi-project test suite must be added to cover the S3 store backend and real Cloud ticket volume/diversity across projects REB and DIG.

The test suite must enforce read-only invariants structurally by monkeypatching all mutating AcliClient methods (create_issue, update_issue, add_comment, add_label, remove_label, set_entity_property, delete_issue, transition_issue_by_name, unassign_issue, set_parent, update_priority, update_issuetype, update_comment, delete_comment, delete_issue_link) to raise an exception.

Multi-project fetch via compute_snapshot and bridge_preview (Mode.DRY_RUN) must correctly resolve and scope both REB and DIG projects with real volume, maintaining per-project attribution and zero cross-contamination.
Unknown or unmapped project keys must fail closed (raise) rather than silently succeed, enforcing documented fail-closed behavior.

The test suite must use an isolated, throwaway S3-backed store with no production access, deleted after each test run, and assert per-project Jira issue counts remain identical before and after all reconciliation operations.
